jobs.title: Bilingual Program Specialist (Educational Support)
jobs.description:
**Important Details \& Must Haves:**

* Bilingual in Spanish \& English
* Part\-Time \& Full\-Time availability
* Flexible Schedule Monday through Friday
* Open availability from 8:00AM to 7:00PM daily, dependent on scheduling needs daily
* Reliable transportation
* Educational Support experience (or related)

**Position Summary:**

The **Bilingual Program Specialist I/II/III** provides individualized support to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities through one\-on\-one coaching, skill development, educational support, employment preparation, independent living, and community\-based activities. The Program Specialist helps individuals work toward their personal goals while providing support across a variety of settings and maintaining accurate documentation of progress and services.

A key responsibility of this role is providing direct educational support, including assistance with school participation, academic activities, organization, communication, assignments, and educational routines. The Program Specialist adapts instruction and support to each individual's needs and learning style while promoting independence. The ideal candidate is bilingual in English and Spanish, compassionate, organized, adaptable, and comfortable providing individualized support to individuals and communicating effectively with families and caregivers.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Facilitate virtual check\-ins and video sessions with individuals and families to assess progress, review personal goals, and determine support needs.**

* You will lead regular individual and family video sessions to build rapport, monitor progress, review goals, and identify changing support needs using trauma\-informed, person\-centered communication. Bilingual English/Spanish communication will support clear and culturally responsive engagement.

**Provide direct individualized educational support to individuals.**

* You will provide one\-on\-one educational support based on each individual's needs, abilities, learning style, and goals, including school routines, classroom participation, assignments, organization, and time management. Support should encourage participation while promoting independence.

**Support individuals in developing academic and educational skills.**

* You will help individuals develop communication, organization, task completion, problem\-solving, self\-advocacy, study habits, and other skills that support educational success. Instruction will be adapted to each individual's learning style and support needs.

**Plan and lead individualized coaching sessions focused on employment readiness, independent living, educational success, and personal development.**

* You will provide structured, goal\-driven coaching based on each individual's strengths, needs, and goals, including areas such as interview preparation, budgeting, communication, organization, educational participation, and daily living. Coaching should be adapted to the individual's learning style while tracking progress and outcomes.

**Utilize individualized teaching and instructional techniques to support learning and skill development.**

* You will use appropriate strategies such as modeling, prompting, repetition, reinforcement, and step\-by\-step instruction to help individuals learn and practice new skills while gradually increasing independence.

**Support individuals with educational routines, schedules, and responsibilities.**

* You will assist individuals with following educational schedules, transitioning between activities, preparing materials, completing assignments, managing time, and maintaining routines that promote greater independence.

**Conduct virtual work readiness training, including mock interviews, resume workshops, and job search support.**

* You will provide training in resume development, interview preparation, digital literacy, and online job searches, with opportunities for one\-on\-one coaching and bilingual English/Spanish support as needed.

**Provide individualized instruction and skill training across educational, community, employment, and daily living environments.**

* You will help individuals develop and apply skills across educational, community, employment, and daily living settings, including hygiene, cooking, laundry, mobility, community navigation, social skills, and employment\-related skills.

**Design and implement engaging remote community\-based activities, and support transitions to in\-person programming when needed.**

* You will create and facilitate accessible virtual activities that encourage social connection, engagement, and community participation, while providing continuity and support when individuals transition to in\-person programming.

**Collaborate with on\-site staff, job coaches, and program coordinators to coordinate seamless service delivery.**

* You will communicate updates, share documentation, and collaborate with team members to maintain consistency in support plans and services. Bilingual communication may also help strengthen coordination with Spanish\-speaking families.

**Set measurable weekly and monthly objectives to help individuals build communication, life, educational, and employment skills.**

* You will help individuals establish achievable goals related to communication, daily living, education, employment, and personal development. Progress will be monitored and goals adjusted as needed, with support provided in the individual's preferred language when appropriate.

**Track and document individual progress, support needs, and goals using internal agency systems.**

* You will maintain accurate, timely, objective, and confidential records of individual progress, support needs, goals, observations, and follow\-up requirements using agency systems.

**Submit accurate monthly progress notes, service logs, and activity calendars in compliance with agency deadlines.**

jobs.title: Research Coordinator II
jobs.description:
**Job ID** REQ20179536 **Category** Support Services
  
The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at the Keck School of Medicine of USC is seeking a detail\-oriented and highly motivated Research Coordinator II to support clinical trials and observational research in Alzheimer's disease, related dementias, and neurodegenerative disorders.


Working directly under the supervision of Dr. Lon Schneider, Professor of Psychiatry, Neurology, and Gerontology, the Research Coordinator II will oversee the day\-to\-day coordination of study activities, including participant recruitment, regulatory documentation, and data management. The position will support foundation\-funded and industry\-sponsored studies and will work closely with the Principal Investigator, Clinical Research Manager/Clinical Project Manager, study coordinators, sponsors, CROs, USC IRB, Clinical Trials Office, and other institutional partners. The successful candidate will be able to work independently on assigned responsibilities, maintain high\-quality study documentation, support ongoing monitoring, and audit readiness, and contribute to improved regulatory and operational processes across the research program.


**Essential job duties include, but are not limited to:**


* Coordinate study participant activities of sponsor\-initiated and investigator\-initiated research studies, including recruitment, screening, orientation, and correspondence.
* Plan assessments, tests, and other assigned clinical trial activities to meet research objectives and study protocol compliance.
* Monitor data collection and management procedures. Prepare data for analysis and generate and submit accurate, complete, and timely reports in accordance with established project timelines and requirements.
* Maintain regulatory documentation, including submissions, amendments, and informed consent, in compliance with FDA, GCP, IRB, HIPAA, SOPs, sponsor and institutional policies.
* Prepare sites for sponsor monitor visits and internal reviews, quality assurance checks, and audit\-readiness activities.
* Provide ongoing guidance and direction to investigators, research personnel, and study subjects to ensure protocol compliance.
* Assist with training and orientation of research personnel on study\-specific procedures, documentation standards, and regulatory workflows.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The University reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**Required Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree (in life sciences, health sciences, pharmacy, psychology, neuroscience, public health, regulatory science, clinical research, or a related field) or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum two years of administrative or research experience.
* Knowledge of medical environment and terminology
* Knowledge and understanding of federal, state, and institutional research regulations as well as Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and HIPPA regulations.
* Proficiency with MS Office applications
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively.

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Master's degree or graduate training in clinical research, management of drug development, regulatory science, pharmaceutical sciences, public health, or a related field.
* Three or more years of relevant experience
* Experience in Alzheimer's disease, dementia, neurodegenerative disease, neurology, psychiatry, geriatrics, or CNS clinical trials.
* Experience managing and coordinating research activities, including clinical trials and human subjects research.
* Experience preparing or supporting IRB submissions, informed consent documents, case report forms, study manuals, monitor visits, and audits.
* Experience developing and facilitating staff education, training, and orientation.
* Familiarity with USC systems and workflows, including OnCore, IRB submissions, REDCap, SharePoint, sponsor portals, and other Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems and Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS).

**Work Location**


This position is full\-time on\-site and employee must report to work at the USC Health Sciences Campus in Los Angeles, CA when scheduled. Work hours and on\-site days may be subject to change depending on business needs.


**Compensation**


The hourly rate range for this position is $35\.53 \- $46\.59\. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

  

  

Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree Minimum Experience: 2 years Minimum Skills: Administrative or research experience. Knowledge of medical environment and terminology. Knowledge and understanding of federal, state, and institutional research regulations as well as Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and HIPPA regulations. Proficient with MS Office applications. Demonstrated effective communication and writing skills. Ability to multi\-task. Demonstrated ability to work as part of a team as well as independently. Preferred Experience: 3 years Preferred Skills: Staff education and orientation experience. Knowledge of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems and Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS).

jobs.title: RETAIL PRE-PRODUCTION COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**



The Retail Pre\-Production Coordinator is an integral part of Global Merchandises’ supply chain. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in organization, multi\-tasking, self\-management, and strong communication skills. This role is to ensure that Global can efficiently track \& monitor all styles in sampling while setting manageable priorities with our vendors \& internal team to push for timely approvals.



Exceptional critical thinking with the ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple projects with overlapping deadlines is essential for this role. A substantial working knowledge of Microsoft Excel is necessary. The ability to take instruction is paramount, along with the timely management of a varied workload, with pressing deadlines and priorities.



This individual must be highly efficient, dedicated to the task at hand and must be able to communicate effectively, have the tenacity to problem\-solve and work as a team player. This individual submits samples to our licensors for alignment and approval.



This is a critical part of our licensed merchandise process and must be handled quickly and effectively to ensure targets are met. The Pre\-Production Coordinator is responsible for all new development that goes into sampling. Pre\-Production Coordinator must keep track of and communicate any foreseeable production challenges to respective teams and offer solutions.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES**


* Work closely with Production Manager, along with sales \& creative, to ensure all samples are executed correctly \& in a timely fashion.
* Create \& maintain all item set ups when sales team requests new items to assign style numbers.
* Handle Purchase Order Form (POF) requests from sales team \& coordinate with creative team to collect art links/SEP files. Push and set priorities internally with creative team for art links/SEP files. Information needs to be organized in the creative tracker \& sample tracker.
* Manage sample inventory, tracking product \& hitting deadlines.
* Working with manufacturers/vendors to resolve issues during the sample process.
* Provide feedback and continued liaison for required revisions/re\-samples with vendors, keeping sales managers \& production team updated throughout process.
* Maintain \& update sample tracker WIP to keep all sampling organized and follow up with vendors in a timely fashion. Manages workflow, prioritizing consistent follow through with factories on proto and pre\-production sampling.
* Set sampling priorities with vendors based on PO’s and desired deliveries.
* Send out weekly WIPS to vendors to push for all updates on sample ETA’s (Estimated time of Arrival) and DDD’s (Drop Dead Date – for approval).
* Share art links/SEP files with allocated vendor after creative distributes to team.
* Collect all sample images from vendors and send off for brand manager/licensor approval upon receipt (time sensitive) after creative signs off.
* Communicate approval comments and corrections to internal and external channels; trackers, factories/vendors, and partners as applicable.
* Coordinate all sample tracking from vendors and ship physical samples to retailers.
* Review sample requests and identify any sampling/production concerns and provide possible solutions. Communicate necessary information to respective teams.
* Brainstorm new processes that promote efficiencies with order ingestion.
* Handle ad\-hoc duties as they arise \& assist with other projects as needed.


**JOB QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS**

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Downtown L.A. Proper Hotel has masterfully transformed a Renaissance Revival landmark building, part of Curlett \& Beelman’s iconic architectural stamp on Los Angeles. Designer Kelly Wearstler seamlessly elevates 147 rooms and suites with compelling creative design, vintage California influences, and a trove of original works by L.A. artists.



Discover a trio of inviting dining destinations in one historic location, alongside a refined split\-level rooftop pool deck with uninterrupted views of the city lights; plus 12,000 square feet of distinctive event spaces, including two suites that integrate the building’s sporting\-club past by repurposing the vintage basketball court and indoor pool into inspired, unexpected design elements.  

  

**Position Overview**  

The Event Operations Manager is responsible for the seamless execution of all on\-property events, including weddings, corporate meetings, social celebrations, and private dining experiences. Serving as the operational lead for banquet and event services, this role ensures exceptional service standards, precise coordination, and memorable guest experiences aligned with the elevated expectations of a boutique luxury hotel environment.



This position collaborates closely with the Sales \& Events team, Culinary, and hotel leadership to transform event plans into flawless on\-site experiences while maintaining the highest standards of hospitality, presentation, and operational efficiency.


***Key Responsibilities***


**Event Operations \& Execution**


* Oversee the setup, service, and breakdown of all banquets, meetings, and special events
* Execute event orders (BEOs) with precision, ensuring all details are delivered according to plan
* Serve as the primary on\-site operational contact during events, ensuring seamless coordination between departments
* Maintain exceptional service standards throughout all stages of the event experience
* Ensure all banquet spaces, equipment, and service areas meet luxury presentation standards


**Team Leadership**


* Recruit, train, schedule, and supervise banquet servers, bartenders, and event support staff
* Lead pre\-event briefings to communicate service expectations, timelines, and guest details
* Foster a culture of professionalism, hospitality, and teamwork among event staff
* Monitor service performance and provide coaching to maintain elevated service standards


**Guest Experience**


* Anticipate guest needs and resolve service issues with professionalism and urgency
* Maintain a visible presence during events to ensure guest satisfaction
* Build positive relationships with repeat clients, planners, and VIP guests


**Operational Coordination**


* Partner closely with the Events/Sales team to review event details, timelines, and client expectations
* Coordinate with Culinary regarding menu timing, special requests, and dietary needs
* Ensure proper inventory, equipment readiness, and event setup according to specifications
* Monitor labor and operational efficiency while maintaining service quality


**Standards \& Compliance**


* Ensure adherence to all health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol service regulations
* Maintain cleanliness, organization, and safety of banquet areas, storage, and service stations
* Support sustainability and waste\-reduction initiatives where possible

### **Qualifications**


* 3–5\+ years of experience in banquet or event operations within an upscale hotel, luxury venue, or fine\-dining environment
* Proven experience leading banquet or event service teams
* Strong knowledge of banquet service styles, event setup standards, and hospitality etiquette
* Exceptional organizational and time\-management skills
* Ability to remain calm and solutions\-oriented in fast\-paced environments
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays as required by event operations

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in a luxury or boutique hotel environment
* Knowledge of POS systems and event management software
* Food safety and alcohol service certifications (e.g., ServSafe, TIPS)


**Salary**


* $80,000\-85,000

  

  

**Why Join Proper Hospitality**



At Proper, we build experiences that move people — and that begins with the team behind them. As a best\-in\-class employer, we’re committed to creating one of the **Best Places to Work** in hospitality by nurturing a culture where creativity, excellence, and humanity thrive together.



Everything we do is grounded in the belief that hospitality is more than a profession \- it’s an opportunity to care for others and make lives better. Guided by the **Pillars of Proper**, we show up with warmth and authenticity (Care Proper), strive for excellence in everything we do (Achieve Proper), think creatively and resourcefully (Imagine Proper), and take pride in the style and culture that make us who we are (Present Proper).



We believe our people are our greatest strength, and we invest deeply in their wellbeing, growth, and sense of belonging. From comprehensive benefits to meaningful development programs, Proper is designed to help you build a career, and a life, that feels as inspiring as the experiences we create for our guests.


**Our Commitment: Building the Best Place to Work**



Our Best Place to Work initiative is a living commitment — a continuous investment in our people, our culture, and our purpose. We listen, learn, and evolve together to create an environment where everyone feels empowered to imagine boldly, achieve confidently, care deeply, and present themselves authentically.



At Proper, joining the team means more than finding a job — it means joining a community that believes in **building beautiful experiences together**, for our guests and for one another.

jobs.title: Community Manager - Alister Sherman Oaks
jobs.description:
At Mill Creek Residential we are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where our associates can grow and bring their whole selves to work. This starts with our recruiting and hiring process. We want you to know that we encourage you to apply if this job excites you, even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements. You may just be the right candidate for this role, or another role and make your mark at Mill Creek.
  
  

The Community Manager drives financial performance, operational and leasing excellence, and delivers outstanding customer service at one or more communities. Provides leadership and management for the community operations and maintenance teams. This position is responsible for setting performance standards and coaching, developing, and empowering associates towards achievement of desired business outcome.
  
Essential Functions/Responsibilities
  
Financial Performance
  
* Manage financial aspects of operations for the assigned community (or communities) that contribute to the business goals.
* Develop, implement, and monitor programs to maximize revenue, maintain expense control, and increase value
* Oversee pricing and occupancy strategies
* Assist in preparation of community budget
* Provide thorough and strategic monthly reforecast, monthly operating report, and executive summary of operations
* Review and approve, or submit for approval, all contracts within the limits defined by MCR budget authority levels
* Anticipate and communicate significant departures from the budget immediately and in accordance with the company policy and standards
* Partner with community Service Manager to review and recommend capital improvements and capital programs for expense reduction
* Address and complete all other duties as assigned


Sales and Marketing
  
* Oversee sales, lease renewals, move\-in and move\-out process
* Oversee administration and completion of the resident renewal program, move\-in and move out process
* Maintain accurate and in\-depth knowledge of community inventory, pricing and availability as well as general knowledge of competitors
* Foster a thorough understanding of the community’s competitive environment in a submarket and adjust operating strategy accordingly
* Participate in Revenue Management calls when applicable
* Address and complete all other duties as assigned


Operating Standards
  
* Ensure community (communities) maintain brand standards including property presentation, marketing, office and model appearance and associate appearance. Inspect what you expect.
* Review and analyze operations reports to track community performance and understand the impact of local economic conditions on community operations
* Ensure community is compliant with all applicable MCR and Partner (where applicable) procedures and all federal, state and local laws, specifically Fair Housing regulations at the community level
* Partnering with Service Manager, recommend capital improvements for community
* Manage contracts with 3rd party service providers
* Address and complete all other duties as assigned


Associate Management and Development
  
* Responsible for recruiting, hiring, associate scheduling, work assignments, training and performance evaluations
* Empower, engage and develop associates to achieve great performance and desired business outcomes.
* Establish goals and accountability for team. Provide feedback, coaching and support to drive achievement of established goals, reward success: hold one on one meetings with staff members
* Manage performance of subordinates. Conduct performance appraisals; provide development support (i.e. coaching, counseling and training); make decisions regarding hiring or termination of community associates
* Support associate development. Provide targeted training and growth opportunities
* Champion and enforce the Mill Creek Brand Promise, Service Standards and Manifesto
* Address and complete all other duties as assigned


Education and/or Experience
  
* High School diploma or equivalent (GED), Bachelor’s degree or related experience preferred
* 3\-5 years of multi\-family or related property management experience or equivalent experience
* 2 years supervisory experience
* Commitment to, and passion for, providing outstanding customer service
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal)


About the Benefits of joining the Mill Creek Team
  
* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision
* Employer sponsored short and long term disability, Life and ADD insurance401k with employer matching
* Paid time off benefits: Vacation, Sick, Holidays


Mill Creek is an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
Are you ready to contribute to the success of Mill Creek Residential? If so, apply today and become part of an organization that believes in uncompromising integrity, celebrating successes, continuous improvement, and working hard, smart and together!

With uncapped commission potential, your career and the rewards that come with it are within reach.

You’ll be the face and voice of AT\&T to your customers – working independently to deliver personalized sales interactions at scheduled appointments provided to you. You’ll close the deal by offering hands\-on demos, Wi\-Fi assessments, tech delivery and issue resolutions \- keeping customers connected to what matters most to them.

* 1\+ years of commission sales and outside sales experience highly preferred

jobs.title: Social Media Manager (contract)
jobs.description:
We're looking for a hands\-on Social Media Manager \- a creator and strategist who makes things, not a calendar manager. Your job is to produce short\-form content basically every day and turn everything happening around The Realest into content people can't scroll past.


We have an incredible amount of natural content already. Between our founder, the merchandise, the auctions, the athletes and artists, our partners, our customers, and everything happening around the business, you won't have to manufacture much. The job is to recognize the story fast, frame it the right way, shoot and edit it, and get it out. You'll spot it, capture it, package it, and publish it \- quickly.


This is a role built on speed, autonomy, and experimentation. We'd much rather you test ten smart ideas than overthink one for a week. Individual posts that don't land are completely fine, that's the cost of moving fast and learning what works.  

  

**This starts as a contract role with the potential to convert to full\-time down the line.**

 **Create great content, every day**

* Produce short\-form video daily \- recognize the story quickly, frame it, shoot it, edit it, and ship it
* Turn the natural content around us into gold: merchandise, auctions, athletes and artists, partners, customers, and live moments
* Concept, capture, and edit from start to finish — Reels, TikToks, Shorts, Stories, graphics, and real\-time content that feels native to each platform
* Keep the voice unmistakably The Realest — real, in\-the\-know, and made for collectors

**Partner on founder\-led content**

* Work closely with our founder, who's naturally one of the faces of the business
* Spot opportunities for founder\-led content that feels authentic \- never forced, never generic "CEO content"

 **Tell customer and collector stories**

* Fluent in collectible culture, with a home base on X. Comfortable across all platforms, but especially dialed into X, where the collectors are and the conversation happens \- engaging and jumping into the discussions daily, not just posting.
* Catch the reactions when collectors receive their items, and the moments with athletes and partners

**Build formats, not just posts**

* When something works, turn it into a repeatable format, template, or franchise rather than treating every post as a one\-off
* Develop recurring series that give The Realest a recognizable rhythm and identity

**Experiment, measure, and lean in**

* Try a lot, watch what performs, understand why, and double down on what's working
* Stay extremely aware of internet culture, formats, and what's landing — but translate it through an elevated The Realest lens. We should feel current and fast without chasing every meme or trend
* Track views, saves, shares, and follower growth, and turn the numbers into your next move

**Run creator and influencer engagement (secondary)**

* Identify and work with creators, influencers, and brand ambassadors who fit our mission \- a meaningful part of the role, but always secondary to creating great content ourselves

 **Requirements** **Who You Are**

* A maker first — you see the post before you pick up the phone, and you'd rather ship than sit on an idea
* Fast and autonomous: you spot the story and run with it without waiting for a brief
* Fluent in internet culture and where attention is going, with the taste to filter it through an elevated brand lens
* Equal parts creative and analytical — you love a good hook and a good data point
* Someone who genuinely gets why memorabilia matters to the people who collect it

 **What We're Looking For**


Honestly, we care much more about taste, instincts, and great work than about checking traditional experience boxes. We're not counting years.

* **A strong portfolio of short\-form content you've personally shot and edited — this is what matters most**
* Hands\-on craft across filming and editing, with tools like Adobe Premiere, CapCut, or whatever gets you there (phone\-first is fine — we care about the eye, not the gear)
* Fluency across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and Facebook \- the tools, the culture, and how each platform's algorithm actually works
* An instinct for formats and franchises \- you recognize a repeatable idea when you see one
* Comfort with analytics (native platform insights, Google Analytics, and similar) and the instinct to act on what they tell you
* **Based in or around Los Angeles and able to be on\-site, with flexibility to travel for key events**
* A genuine interest in sports, music, or movie memorabilia \- you should get why this stuff matters

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
**Why we exist:**


More than 80% of Americans own a car and see it as a fundamental necessity, yet the experience of owning one is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the user journey (shopping for a car, insurance, repairs, etc) is complicated, fragmented, and time\-consuming, and the costs are staggering. In 2025, the cost of owning a car was more than 20% of the average household income, after tax. At Jerry.ai, we are building the first app to manage it all and make car ownership accessible to all.

**Why we need you:**


Jerry has built a product used by 5 million people, but the real conversations about car insurance and repair aren't happening in our apps—they’re happening on Reddit, Quora, and TikTok. We don’t want to just ‘manage’ these channels; we want to participate in them.


We’re looking for a **Community Manager** who can represent Jerry with authenticity and build trust with our current and future users! You’re someone who knows how to provide genuine value in an r/personalfinance thread and can just as easily navigate the high\-energy culture of a TikTok comment section.

**What you'll own:**

* Build and grow Jerry's organic presence across key channels like Reddit, Quora, YouTube, and TikTok — the places our customers actually congregate
* Develop Jerry's playbook for how to show up in each community: when to post, when to reply, when to stay silent
* Grow Jerry’s subreddits into active, trusted communities
* Build a content and engagement strategy that scales without losing authenticity, leveraging AI where it helps
* Work with Growth and Content teams to ensure consistency across channels
* Measure what matters: sentiment, share of voice, referral traffic, and LLM citation

**Who you are:**

* A platform native with a visceral dislike of corporate\-speak — you write with a tone that earns upvotes and moves naturally across Reddit, TikTok, and Quora
* 3\+ years in community management or organic social, ideally in fintech, insurtech, or another consumer facing and/or regulated category
* A strategic operator who builds systems, not just vibes — you understand SEO and how LLMs cite sources
* Proven ability to make "boring" or "stressful" categories feel human, authentic, and worth following
* A patient, curious long\-game player who values organic trust over quick PR wins

*While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.*

***Please note:*** ***Jerry.ai*** ***is only able to hire full\-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full\-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.***

*Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.*

*Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at* *recruiting@jerry.ai*

*The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job\-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market\-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.*

*We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part\-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.*

**About Jerry.ai**


Your car and your home are your most expensive assets. And for most people, these aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.


Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair or, worse, an accident, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.


Jerry is building the first AI agent to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.


We've reached 5M\+ customers, raised $240M\+, and have been profitable since 2024\. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.


We’re fully remote with offices in Palo Alto, New York, Chicago, and Toronto.

  

Compensation Range: $75K \- $110K

About us

ROOFCORP of America has been repairing, restoring, and replacing commercial flat roofs since 1985\. We work in TPO, built\-up roofing, and silicone restoration for building owners and property managers across California, Oregon, Washington, and Alaska. We are a family\-run company with a simple standard: do honest work, do it right, and take care of the customer. Quality here is personal, not a department.

Our Anaheim office runs our Pacific Southwest operations. This is a working office — steady volume, real deadlines, and a team that supports each other.

The role

The Sales Coordinator is the hub of our sales operation. Our estimators are out on roofs and our sales team is in front of customers — you are the person who makes sure nothing behind them falls through the cracks. Proposals go out on time, bids get submitted before the deadline, follow\-ups actually happen, and our customer records are accurate.

If you like order, deadlines, and being the person everyone relies on, you will do well here.

What you'll do

Take in incoming leads, service calls, and bid invitations, and log every one of them accurately the same day.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best\-in\-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in.


Ferguson is seeking a proven **Outside Sales Representative \- Facilities Supply** to fill an immediate need with growing market opportunities. If you are self\-motivated, dedicated and can provide phenomenal customer service coupled with a passion for contributing directly to the bottom line of a multi\-billion\-dollar organization, this is the position for you!


This is a field\-based sales role supporting customers in the South LA / South Bay Gateway area. This position will need to be based in the Los Angeles area. A fuel card, auto allowance, travel and expense card, company cell phone \& laptop will be provided.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain relationships with assigned customers and vendors, collaborating with other branch associates to ensure flawless service from order to delivery and beyond.
* Grow “share of wallet” spend with active, new, and inactive customers by developing trust\-based relationships.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand the current customer base, devising and implementing sales strategies in collaboration with management.
* Perform product quotations and resolve customer issues with a focus on outstanding service.
* Analyze competition within the territory, developing and communicating sales strategies to management.
* Continuously improve sales skills and product knowledge to maintain a professional image and boost performance both in the field and internally.
* Document all sales activities in our internal CRM tool (Salesforce) and Map My Customer to evaluate the new business pipeline and measure sales closure results.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 3 years of industry\-related and/or outside field sales experience is preferred.
* Experience and success within the Multifamily and/or Hospitality vertical, working with General Managers, Facility/Maintenance supervisors, and engineers is beneficial.
* Proven sales experience in a distribution and/or manufacturing environment is advantageous.
* Strong problem\-solving, leadership, and active listening skills.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to multi\-task, learn quickly, and retain information.
* Driven to meet objectives while possessing solid communication, time management, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams).


This is a base plus commission\-eligible role, with no cap on your commission. The estimated total compensation range, based on performance and experience, is $75,000 \- $100,000\+.


At Ferguson, we care for each other. We value our well\-being just as much as our hard work. We are committed to a holistic approach towards benefits plans and programs that support the mental, physical and financial well\-being of our associates. Our competitive offering not only includes benefits like health, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance and a 401(k) with a company match, but our associates also enjoy additional meaningful and inclusive enhancements that are adaptable to their diverse situations and needs, including mental health coverage, gender affirming and family building benefits, paid parental leave, associate discounts, community involvement opportunities and more!

new_jobs.title: Bilingual Program Specialist (Educational Support)
new_jobs.description:
**Important Details \& Must Haves:**

* Bilingual in Spanish \& English
* Part\-Time \& Full\-Time availability
* Flexible Schedule Monday through Friday
* Open availability from 8:00AM to 7:00PM daily, dependent on scheduling needs daily
* Reliable transportation
* Educational Support experience (or related)

**Position Summary:**

The **Bilingual Program Specialist I/II/III** provides individualized support to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities through one\-on\-one coaching, skill development, educational support, employment preparation, independent living, and community\-based activities. The Program Specialist helps individuals work toward their personal goals while providing support across a variety of settings and maintaining accurate documentation of progress and services.

A key responsibility of this role is providing direct educational support, including assistance with school participation, academic activities, organization, communication, assignments, and educational routines. The Program Specialist adapts instruction and support to each individual's needs and learning style while promoting independence. The ideal candidate is bilingual in English and Spanish, compassionate, organized, adaptable, and comfortable providing individualized support to individuals and communicating effectively with families and caregivers.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Facilitate virtual check\-ins and video sessions with individuals and families to assess progress, review personal goals, and determine support needs.**

* You will lead regular individual and family video sessions to build rapport, monitor progress, review goals, and identify changing support needs using trauma\-informed, person\-centered communication. Bilingual English/Spanish communication will support clear and culturally responsive engagement.

**Provide direct individualized educational support to individuals.**

* You will provide one\-on\-one educational support based on each individual's needs, abilities, learning style, and goals, including school routines, classroom participation, assignments, organization, and time management. Support should encourage participation while promoting independence.

**Support individuals in developing academic and educational skills.**

* You will help individuals develop communication, organization, task completion, problem\-solving, self\-advocacy, study habits, and other skills that support educational success. Instruction will be adapted to each individual's learning style and support needs.

**Plan and lead individualized coaching sessions focused on employment readiness, independent living, educational success, and personal development.**

* You will provide structured, goal\-driven coaching based on each individual's strengths, needs, and goals, including areas such as interview preparation, budgeting, communication, organization, educational participation, and daily living. Coaching should be adapted to the individual's learning style while tracking progress and outcomes.

**Utilize individualized teaching and instructional techniques to support learning and skill development.**

* You will use appropriate strategies such as modeling, prompting, repetition, reinforcement, and step\-by\-step instruction to help individuals learn and practice new skills while gradually increasing independence.

**Support individuals with educational routines, schedules, and responsibilities.**

* You will assist individuals with following educational schedules, transitioning between activities, preparing materials, completing assignments, managing time, and maintaining routines that promote greater independence.

**Conduct virtual work readiness training, including mock interviews, resume workshops, and job search support.**

* You will provide training in resume development, interview preparation, digital literacy, and online job searches, with opportunities for one\-on\-one coaching and bilingual English/Spanish support as needed.

**Provide individualized instruction and skill training across educational, community, employment, and daily living environments.**

new_jobs.description:
**Job ID** REQ20179536 **Category** Support Services
  
The Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at the Keck School of Medicine of USC is seeking a detail\-oriented and highly motivated Research Coordinator II to support clinical trials and observational research in Alzheimer's disease, related dementias, and neurodegenerative disorders.


Working directly under the supervision of Dr. Lon Schneider, Professor of Psychiatry, Neurology, and Gerontology, the Research Coordinator II will oversee the day\-to\-day coordination of study activities, including participant recruitment, regulatory documentation, and data management. The position will support foundation\-funded and industry\-sponsored studies and will work closely with the Principal Investigator, Clinical Research Manager/Clinical Project Manager, study coordinators, sponsors, CROs, USC IRB, Clinical Trials Office, and other institutional partners. The successful candidate will be able to work independently on assigned responsibilities, maintain high\-quality study documentation, support ongoing monitoring, and audit readiness, and contribute to improved regulatory and operational processes across the research program.


**Essential job duties include, but are not limited to:**


* Coordinate study participant activities of sponsor\-initiated and investigator\-initiated research studies, including recruitment, screening, orientation, and correspondence.
* Plan assessments, tests, and other assigned clinical trial activities to meet research objectives and study protocol compliance.
* Monitor data collection and management procedures. Prepare data for analysis and generate and submit accurate, complete, and timely reports in accordance with established project timelines and requirements.
* Maintain regulatory documentation, including submissions, amendments, and informed consent, in compliance with FDA, GCP, IRB, HIPAA, SOPs, sponsor and institutional policies.
* Prepare sites for sponsor monitor visits and internal reviews, quality assurance checks, and audit\-readiness activities.
* Provide ongoing guidance and direction to investigators, research personnel, and study subjects to ensure protocol compliance.
* Assist with training and orientation of research personnel on study\-specific procedures, documentation standards, and regulatory workflows.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The University reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**Required Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree (in life sciences, health sciences, pharmacy, psychology, neuroscience, public health, regulatory science, clinical research, or a related field) or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum two years of administrative or research experience.
* Knowledge of medical environment and terminology
* Knowledge and understanding of federal, state, and institutional research regulations as well as Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and HIPPA regulations.
* Proficiency with MS Office applications
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively.

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Master's degree or graduate training in clinical research, management of drug development, regulatory science, pharmaceutical sciences, public health, or a related field.
* Three or more years of relevant experience
* Experience in Alzheimer's disease, dementia, neurodegenerative disease, neurology, psychiatry, geriatrics, or CNS clinical trials.
* Experience managing and coordinating research activities, including clinical trials and human subjects research.
* Experience preparing or supporting IRB submissions, informed consent documents, case report forms, study manuals, monitor visits, and audits.
* Experience developing and facilitating staff education, training, and orientation.
* Familiarity with USC systems and workflows, including OnCore, IRB submissions, REDCap, SharePoint, sponsor portals, and other Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems and Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS).

**Work Location**


This position is full\-time on\-site and employee must report to work at the USC Health Sciences Campus in Los Angeles, CA when scheduled. Work hours and on\-site days may be subject to change depending on business needs.


**Compensation**


The hourly rate range for this position is $35\.53 \- $46\.59\. **JOB SUMMARY:**



The Retail Pre\-Production Coordinator is an integral part of Global Merchandises’ supply chain. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in organization, multi\-tasking, self\-management, and strong communication skills. This role is to ensure that Global can efficiently track \& monitor all styles in sampling while setting manageable priorities with our vendors \& internal team to push for timely approvals.



Exceptional critical thinking with the ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple projects with overlapping deadlines is essential for this role. A substantial working knowledge of Microsoft Excel is necessary. The ability to take instruction is paramount, along with the timely management of a varied workload, with pressing deadlines and priorities.



This individual must be highly efficient, dedicated to the task at hand and must be able to communicate effectively, have the tenacity to problem\-solve and work as a team player. This individual submits samples to our licensors for alignment and approval.



This is a critical part of our licensed merchandise process and must be handled quickly and effectively to ensure targets are met. The Pre\-Production Coordinator is responsible for all new development that goes into sampling. Pre\-Production Coordinator must keep track of and communicate any foreseeable production challenges to respective teams and offer solutions.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES**


* Work closely with Production Manager, along with sales \& creative, to ensure all samples are executed correctly \& in a timely fashion.
* Create \& maintain all item set ups when sales team requests new items to assign style numbers.
* Handle Purchase Order Form (POF) requests from sales team \& coordinate with creative team to collect art links/SEP files. Push and set priorities internally with creative team for art links/SEP files. Information needs to be organized in the creative tracker \& sample tracker.
* Manage sample inventory, tracking product \& hitting deadlines.
* Working with manufacturers/vendors to resolve issues during the sample process.
* Provide feedback and continued liaison for required revisions/re\-samples with vendors, keeping sales managers \& production team updated throughout process.
* Maintain \& update sample tracker WIP to keep all sampling organized and follow up with vendors in a timely fashion. Manages workflow, prioritizing consistent follow through with factories on proto and pre\-production sampling.
* Set sampling priorities with vendors based on PO’s and desired deliveries.
* Send out weekly WIPS to vendors to push for all updates on sample ETA’s (Estimated time of Arrival) and DDD’s (Drop Dead Date – for approval).
* Share art links/SEP files with allocated vendor after creative distributes to team.
* Collect all sample images from vendors and send off for brand manager/licensor approval upon receipt (time sensitive) after creative signs off.
* Communicate approval comments and corrections to internal and external channels; trackers, factories/vendors, and partners as applicable.
* Coordinate all sample tracking from vendors and ship physical samples to retailers.
* Review sample requests and identify any sampling/production concerns and provide possible solutions. Communicate necessary information to respective teams.
* Brainstorm new processes that promote efficiencies with order ingestion.
* Handle ad\-hoc duties as they arise \& assist with other projects as needed.


**JOB QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS**


* Bachelor’s Degree (Preferred) or equivalent work experience
* Must have the ability to multi\-task and prioritize in a fast\-paced, time\-pressured environment.
* Outstanding verbal \& written communications skills and able to liaise internally with various teams such as production/sales/brand mgmt. and externally with manufacturers/vendors/customers.

**Location:** 20950 Warner Center Lane, Suite A, Woodland Hills, CA 91367 (in\-office, not remote)

Tuesday: 9:30 AM to 2:30 PM (group interview day)

**Job description:**

The League LLC is a growing solar sales organization in Woodland Hills. We recruit and train new sales representatives continuously, and we are looking for one organized, self\-directed person to own the entire recruiting pipeline from first application to the moment a candidate walks into training.

This is not a role where someone will be looking over your shoulder. We want a person who can take the process, run it, and improve it.

Review and respond to roughly 150 inbound applications per week across Indeed and our other recruiting channels.

Identify the strongest candidates and call them directly rather than sending everyone the same generic message.

Invite candidates to our weekly Tuesday group interview, then confirm attendance by phone and text in the days leading up to it.

Attend the Tuesday group interview to check candidates in and track exactly who applied, who confirmed, and who actually showed.

Track hire outcomes and build the reporting that tells us what is working and what is not.

Run structured follow\-up campaigns in GoHighLevel for candidates who did not show, did not get hired, or went quiet.

Keep our recruiting records and org chart accurate and current in GoHighLevel.

Do light sourcing on LinkedIn and other channels when the inbound pipeline is slow.

Participate in our daily team meeting from 1:00 to 2:00, Tuesday through Friday.

Handle occasional general office and administrative tasks.

**What we require:**

Hands\-on experience with GoHighLevel, or strong experience with a comparable CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or Keap. Honestly, if you know GoHighLevel better than we do, that is a plus.

Comfort making outbound phone calls. This is not a heavy call volume role, but you will be on the phone every day.

Strong written communication. You will be texting and emailing candidates constantly and you represent us.

The ability to work independently and manage your own day without being assigned tasks.

Reliable availability every Tuesday from 9:30 AM to 2:30 PM. That is our group interview day and it is non\-negotiable.

Reliable transportation to our Woodland Hills office. Parking is free and covered.

**What we offer:**

$30\.00 per hour, which is well above market for a part\-time coordinator role, because we want someone we can actually trust with this.

Up to $500 per month in performance bonus tied to interview show rate and hires.

Free covered parking.

Paid sick leave and all benefits required under California and City of Los Angeles law.

A consistent midday schedule that leaves your mornings and afternoons open.

* Oversee the setup, service, and breakdown of all banquets, meetings, and special events

* Recruit, train, schedule, and supervise banquet servers, bartenders, and event support staff

**Salary**


* $80,000\-85,000

Our Best Place to Work initiative is a living commitment — a continuous investment in our people, our culture, and our purpose. We listen, learn, and evolve together to create an environment where everyone feels empowered to imagine boldly, achieve confidently, care deeply, and present themselves authentically.

new_jobs.title: Community Manager - Alister Sherman Oaks
new_jobs.description:
At Mill Creek Residential we are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where our associates can grow and bring their whole selves to work. This starts with our recruiting and hiring process. We want you to know that we encourage you to apply if this job excites you, even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements. You may just be the right candidate for this role, or another role and make your mark at Mill Creek.
  
  

The Community Manager drives financial performance, operational and leasing excellence, and delivers outstanding customer service at one or more communities. Provides leadership and management for the community operations and maintenance teams. This position is responsible for setting performance standards and coaching, developing, and empowering associates towards achievement of desired business outcome.
  
Essential Functions/Responsibilities
  
Financial Performance
  
* Manage financial aspects of operations for the assigned community (or communities) that contribute to the business goals.
* Develop, implement, and monitor programs to maximize revenue, maintain expense control, and increase value
* Oversee pricing and occupancy strategies
* Assist in preparation of community budget
* Provide thorough and strategic monthly reforecast, monthly operating report, and executive summary of operations
* Review and approve, or submit for approval, all contracts within the limits defined by MCR budget authority levels
* Anticipate and communicate significant departures from the budget immediately and in accordance with the company policy and standards
* Partner with community Service Manager to review and recommend capital improvements and capital programs for expense reduction
* Address and complete all other duties as assigned


Sales and Marketing
  
* Oversee sales, lease renewals, move\-in and move\-out process
* Oversee administration and completion of the resident renewal program, move\-in and move out process
* Maintain accurate and in\-depth knowledge of community inventory, pricing and availability as well as general knowledge of competitors
* Foster a thorough understanding of the community’s competitive environment in a submarket and adjust operating strategy accordingly
* Participate in Revenue Management calls when applicable
* Address and complete all other duties as assigned


Operating Standards
  
* Ensure community (communities) maintain brand standards including property presentation, marketing, office and model appearance and associate appearance. Inspect what you expect.
* Review and analyze operations reports to track community performance and understand the impact of local economic conditions on community operations
* Ensure community is compliant with all applicable MCR and Partner (where applicable) procedures and all federal, state and local laws, specifically Fair Housing regulations at the community level
* Partnering with Service Manager, recommend capital improvements for community
* Manage contracts with 3rd party service providers
* Address and complete all other duties as assigned


Associate Management and Development
  
* Responsible for recruiting, hiring, associate scheduling, work assignments, training and performance evaluations
* Empower, engage and develop associates to achieve great performance and desired business outcomes.
* Establish goals and accountability for team. Provide feedback, coaching and support to drive achievement of established goals, reward success: hold one on one meetings with staff members
* Manage performance of subordinates. Conduct performance appraisals; provide development support (i.e. coaching, counseling and training); make decisions regarding hiring or termination of community associates
* Support associate development. Provide targeted training and growth opportunities
* Champion and enforce the Mill Creek Brand Promise, Service Standards and Manifesto
* Address and complete all other duties as assigned


Education and/or Experience
  
* High School diploma or equivalent (GED), Bachelor’s degree or related experience preferred
* 3\-5 years of multi\-family or related property management experience or equivalent experience
* 2 years supervisory experience
* Commitment to, and passion for, providing outstanding customer service
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal)


About the Benefits of joining the Mill Creek Team
  
* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision
* Employer sponsored short and long term disability, Life and ADD insurance401k with employer matching
* Paid time off benefits: Vacation, Sick, Holidays


Mill Creek is an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
Are you ready to contribute to the success of Mill Creek Residential? If so, apply today and become part of an organization that believes in uncompromising integrity, celebrating successes, continuous improvement, and working hard, smart and together!

Join an elite group of sales professionals bringing customized, white glove experiences directly in the customer’s home. Sr In Home Sales Experts at AT\&T are driven to connect – every interaction is an opportunity to introduce the latest technology and services, thriving on the challenge to make your sales goals happen. With uncapped commission potential, your career and the rewards that come with it are within reach.


Our **Sr. In\-Home Sales Experts** earn between $59,310 to $100,000, including the salary and our uncapped commission opportunities. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training. Salary range is dependent on if all sales goals are met and/or exceeded


You’ll be the face and voice of AT\&T to your customers – working independently to deliver personalized sales interactions at scheduled appointments provided to you. You’ll close the deal by offering hands\-on demos, Wi\-Fi assessments, tech delivery and issue resolutions \- keeping customers connected to what matters most to them.

**How you get the job done:**

* We’ll kick things off with paid training –setting you up for success to work independently in the field. Coaching, mentoring and ongoing learning opportunities will keep you on track and tech\-savvy
* You’ll connect with our existing customers daily. AT\&T will provide scheduled appointments, giving you the opportunity to engage with warm prospects effectively.
* You’ll use strong negotiation and communications skills – you know how to make a smooth pivot, and are highly motivated to get it right and make the sale

**Key expectations to succeed:**

* 1\+ years of commission sales and outside sales experience highly preferred
* Demonstrated success in commission sales and achieving sales targets
* Proficient in upselling techniques that enhance customer value and satisfaction
* Strong verbal communication skills with an ability to build rapport quickly
* Maintain a valid driver’s license—be ready to drive, as we provide a company vehicle for **official business use only**
* Work a varied schedule designed to meet customers on their timeline –this includes evenings, weekends, and holidays
* Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, including drug screening, criminal history, and motor vehicle record


If you are considering jobs like Direct Sales Representative, Residential Sales Representative, Territory Sales Representative or Field Sales Executive – Home Solutions, this career move would be a great fit!

**Joining our team comes with amazing perks and benefits:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Paid Time off and holidays (With some exceptions, bargained employees qualify for one week of PTO after 6 months of service and 2 weeks after the first year). At least 6 company designated holidays and additional PTO (based on bargaining group to which you are hired.
* Sick leave
* Paid Parental Leave
* Adoption Reimbursement
* Disability Benefits (short term and long term)
* Life and Accidental Death Insurance
* Supplemental benefit programs: critical illness, accident hospital indemnity/group legal
* Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
* Employee discounts up to 50% off on eligible AT\&T mobility plans and accessories, AT\&T internet (and fiber where available) and AT\&T phone
* A company paid device and service plan, giving you first\-hand expertise with our latest technology.


Ready to take your career on a new route? Apply today.

new_jobs.title: Community Manager - Alister Sherman Oaks
new_jobs.description:
4440 Sepulveda Blvd, Sherman Oaks, CA 91403, USA


Job Description
Posted Monday, August 24, 2026, 12:00 AM**At Mill Creek Residential we are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where our associates can grow and bring their whole selves to work. This starts with our recruiting and hiring process. We want you to know that we encourage you to apply if this job excites you, even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements. You may just be the right candidate for this role, or another role and make your mark at Mill Creek.**


The Community Manager drives financial performance, operational and leasing excellence, and delivers outstanding customer service at one or more communities. Provides leadership and management for the community operations and maintenance teams. This position is responsible for setting performance standards and coaching, developing, and empowering associates towards achievement of desired business outcome.



Essential Functions/Responsibilities



Financial Performance


* Manage financial aspects of operations for the assigned community (or communities) that contribute to the business goals.
* Develop, implement, and monitor programs to maximize revenue, maintain expense control, and increase value
* Oversee pricing and occupancy strategies
* Assist in preparation of community budget
* Provide thorough and strategic monthly reforecast, monthly operating report, and executive summary of operations
* Review and approve, or submit for approval, all contracts within the limits defined by MCR budget authority levels
* Anticipate and communicate significant departures from the budget immediately and in accordance with the company policy and standards
* Partner with community Service Manager to review and recommend capital improvements and capital programs for expense reduction
* Address and complete all other duties as assigned


Sales and Marketing


* Oversee sales, lease renewals, move\-in and move\-out process
* Oversee administration and completion of the resident renewal program, move\-in and move out process
* Maintain accurate and in\-depth knowledge of community inventory, pricing and availability as well as general knowledge of competitors
* Foster a thorough understanding of the community’s competitive environment in a submarket and adjust operating strategy accordingly
* Participate in Revenue Management calls when applicable
* Address and complete all other duties as assigned


Operating Standards


* Ensure community (communities) maintain brand standards including property presentation, marketing, office and model appearance and associate appearance. Inspect what you expect.
* Review and analyze operations reports to track community performance and understand the impact of local economic conditions on community operations
* Ensure community is compliant with all applicable MCR and Partner (where applicable) procedures and all federal, state and local laws, specifically Fair Housing regulations at the community level
* Partnering with Service Manager, recommend capital improvements for community
* Manage contracts with 3rd party service providers
* Address and complete all other duties as assigned


Associate Management and Development


* Responsible for recruiting, hiring, associate scheduling, work assignments, training and performance evaluations
* Empower, engage and develop associates to achieve great performance and desired business outcomes.
* Establish goals and accountability for team. Provide feedback, coaching and support to drive achievement of established goals, reward success: hold one on one meetings with staff members
* Manage performance of subordinates. Conduct performance appraisals; provide development support (i.e. coaching, counseling and training); make decisions regarding hiring or termination of community associates
* Support associate development. Provide targeted training and growth opportunities
* Champion and enforce the Mill Creek Brand Promise, Service Standards and Manifesto
* Address and complete all other duties as assigned

Education and/or Experience


* High School diploma or equivalent (GED), Bachelor’s degree or related experience preferred
* 3\-5 years of multi\-family or related property management experience or equivalent experience
* 2 years supervisory experience
* Commitment to, and passion for, providing outstanding customer service
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal)


**About the Benefits of joining the Mill Creek Team**


* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision
* Employer sponsored short and long term disability, Life and ADD insurance401k with employer matching
* Paid time off benefits: Vacation, Sick, Holidays
*Mill Creek is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager (contract)
new_jobs.description:
We're looking for a hands\-on Social Media Manager \- a creator and strategist who makes things, not a calendar manager. Your job is to produce short\-form content basically every day and turn everything happening around The Realest into content people can't scroll past.


We have an incredible amount of natural content already. Between our founder, the merchandise, the auctions, the athletes and artists, our partners, our customers, and everything happening around the business, you won't have to manufacture much. The job is to recognize the story fast, frame it the right way, shoot and edit it, and get it out. You'll spot it, capture it, package it, and publish it \- quickly.


This is a role built on speed, autonomy, and experimentation. We'd much rather you test ten smart ideas than overthink one for a week. Individual posts that don't land are completely fine, that's the cost of moving fast and learning what works.  

  

**This starts as a contract role with the potential to convert to full\-time down the line.**

 **Create great content, every day**

* Produce short\-form video daily \- recognize the story quickly, frame it, shoot it, edit it, and ship it
* Turn the natural content around us into gold: merchandise, auctions, athletes and artists, partners, customers, and live moments
* Concept, capture, and edit from start to finish — Reels, TikToks, Shorts, Stories, graphics, and real\-time content that feels native to each platform
* Keep the voice unmistakably The Realest — real, in\-the\-know, and made for collectors

**Partner on founder\-led content**

* Work closely with our founder, who's naturally one of the faces of the business
* Spot opportunities for founder\-led content that feels authentic \- never forced, never generic "CEO content"

 **Tell customer and collector stories**

* Fluent in collectible culture, with a home base on X. Comfortable across all platforms, but especially dialed into X, where the collectors are and the conversation happens \- engaging and jumping into the discussions daily, not just posting.
* Catch the reactions when collectors receive their items, and the moments with athletes and partners

**Build formats, not just posts**

* When something works, turn it into a repeatable format, template, or franchise rather than treating every post as a one\-off
* Develop recurring series that give The Realest a recognizable rhythm and identity

**Experiment, measure, and lean in**

* Try a lot, watch what performs, understand why, and double down on what's working
* Stay extremely aware of internet culture, formats, and what's landing — but translate it through an elevated The Realest lens. We should feel current and fast without chasing every meme or trend
* Track views, saves, shares, and follower growth, and turn the numbers into your next move

**Run creator and influencer engagement (secondary)**

* Identify and work with creators, influencers, and brand ambassadors who fit our mission \- a meaningful part of the role, but always secondary to creating great content ourselves

 **Requirements** **Who You Are**

* A maker first — you see the post before you pick up the phone, and you'd rather ship than sit on an idea
* Fast and autonomous: you spot the story and run with it without waiting for a brief
* Fluent in internet culture and where attention is going, with the taste to filter it through an elevated brand lens
* Equal parts creative and analytical — you love a good hook and a good data point
* Someone who genuinely gets why memorabilia matters to the people who collect it

 **What We're Looking For**


Honestly, we care much more about taste, instincts, and great work than about checking traditional experience boxes. We're not counting years.

* **A strong portfolio of short\-form content you've personally shot and edited — this is what matters most**
* Hands\-on craft across filming and editing, with tools like Adobe Premiere, CapCut, or whatever gets you there (phone\-first is fine — we care about the eye, not the gear)
* Fluency across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and Facebook \- the tools, the culture, and how each platform's algorithm actually works
* An instinct for formats and franchises \- you recognize a repeatable idea when you see one
* Comfort with analytics (native platform insights, Google Analytics, and similar) and the instinct to act on what they tell you
* **Based in or around Los Angeles and able to be on\-site, with flexibility to travel for key events**
* A genuine interest in sports, music, or movie memorabilia \- you should get why this stuff matters
